description: Instant estimate of the paid 3D stand-design fee (EUR). Rate 5–15 €/sqm: lower per sqm for larger stands, higher for a higher planned construction budget per sqm (a proxy for bespoke detail and multimedia). The fee is refunded in full when the stand is built with People Can. Final quote always confirmed by email. Construction itself typically runs 300–800 €/sqm excl. space rental and venue services.

budget_per_sqm.description: Planned construction budget per sqm in EUR (300–800)

sqm.description: Stand floor area in square meters
